test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The old man advised him to always speak the truth.

options.text: The old man said to him, “Always speak the truth.”
“I advised you to always speak the truth,” the old man said.
“Truth shall always be spoken,” advised the old man.
The old man advised, “Truth be told.”

solution:
The correct answer is ***The old man said to him, “Always speak the truth.”***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We need to convert the indirect speech to direct speech.
 
• The reporting verb is changed to '**said'** from **'advised'**.
 
• Punctuation marks including commas and inverted commas are introduced.
 
• The word 'to' is removed in direct speech.
 
• The structure of the sentence in option 1 closely resembles that of the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2** incorrectly attributes the speaker as saying "I advised you to always speak the truth," which changes the perspective of the advice. 
 
• **Option 3 **alters the wording of the original sentence while maintaining the structure. However, it changes the emphasis of the advice, focusing more on the concept of truth being spoken rather than the action of speaking the truth.
 
• **Option 4 **presents the advice in a different form, altering the wording significantly. It doesn't directly convey the instruction to "always speak the truth" as in the original sentence.
